description: Rogers explains her vote for SB 1189, citing real threats against her life. She argues that public service should not mean putting elected officials and their families in danger. Watch now: SB 1189 strengthens privacy and safety protections for elected officials and their families. https://www.azleg.gov/legtext/57leg/2R/bills/SB1189P.pdf
